decision_contract: predict close(t+20)/close(t) using only feature rows preceding t; no same-close execution assumption
availability_policy: Raw auxiliaries source-row lag 0 as original SP500 config; X[i-20:i] excludes target date. All source-date day-end availability bounds precede target-date 16:00 New York cutoff.
checks: frozen raw input integrity; no target-close imputation
all source-availability bounds precede U.S. target cutoffs
future perturbation cannot affect past features
all input dates strictly before target dates
data_limit: Yahoo histories are not point-in-time vintage databases. Audit verifies calendar causality under declared availability bounds, not historical vendor revisions or exact intraday publication timestamps.
